delivery: Natural and conversational, without emotion tags.

clips.text: Here are two ideas I’d explore in my first thirty days. First: incoming voice notes. WhatsApp already offers transcripts. I’d prototype a Flow handoff that helps you understand the note and prepare a reply you can review.

I’d start with one everyday moment: catching up on emails from the back seat of a cab. Show someone reading a message, speaking a reply with Flow, then reviewing it. Bring people into Flow through that moment, and learn what they try, where they stop, and whether they use it again.

The campaign line? Wispr है तो, tension क्यों? Your keyboard stops working just before an email needs to go out. A colleague points to Flow. You speak the reply, review it, and carry on. A small office moment that gives the line a reason to stick.
